# Paragon Logistics Ltd. - ISRAEL

Paragon Logistics Ltd. - ISRAEL is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Paragon Logistics is a dynamic provider of comprehensive logistics, supply chain management, and freight operations solutions. They offer a profound and personal approach to the complete supply chain cycle for any size business. Paragon Logistics Ltd. - ISRAEL employs 16 people (+33.3% YoY, +4 people), founded in 2009. Headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel, with presence in United States.

## About

Paragon Logistics offers comprehensive supply chain management solutions, with a dedicated team of professionals in the area of global logistics. 
 
Paragon Logistics provides services through the following three divisions:
 
Logistics Center: Paragon Logistics operates a well-managed, 3,000-sqm logistics center, complying with high standards of global hi-tech companies, and strategically located in close proximity of Ben-Gurion Airport (Tel Aviv International Airport). 
 
Freight Operations: Provides the following services: freight forwarding, customs clearance, ground transportation, global projects, special charters and other added-value services.
 
Consulting Services: Paragon SCM specializes in mapping, optimizing and increasing the efficiency of companies'​ supply chains, through providing a wide range of flexible solutions fulfilling companies'​ SCM requirements, and individually customizing the solutions to their needs and infrastructures. 
 
Paragon Logistics provides an array of Supply Chain solutions for leading multinational and Israeli companies in the areas of hi-tech, network products, electronics manufacturing, fragrance and flavor production, digital press, and more.
